rationale: Shrink-only baseline of the hexagon test gates (RP-7, change order of 2026-11-12; docs/governance/harbor-ro7-placement.md; rules in .gzkit/rules/tests.md § Hexagon tests). It holds every test module covering a region of the package map in pyproject.toml [tool.py-gzkit.hexagon], adapters included and the kernel excluded (operator, 2026-11-13: "Regions incl. adapters", "Exclude the kernel"), measured when the gates landed: a mock finding for a mock import in an inner-region test or a patch of a target inside the package ("Per patch target"), a labels finding for a test method without # given, # when and # then in order, and a covers finding for one without @covers. Today every held module covers gzkit.cli, the one adapter on disk. Keys come from gzkit.governance.trust_audits.hexagon_tests; gz validate --hexagon-tests refuses a key this list does not hold and a held key the tree no longer produces, so the list only shrinks.
